controls.label: Shape
controls.title: Original radar reconstruction archived by NASA/JPL, at its published kilometer scale. The shared grid marks unavailable imagery. This is source geometry, not a photographic surface or reflectance map. This is the archived prograde principal-axis model. The source research also permits a nearly mirrored retrograde solution; the pole and rotational sense are not unique. Near-pole-on observations constrain its unobserved southern shape less strongly. The period is 67.5 ± 6.0 h; a small non-principal-axis component was not excluded. No resolved optical surface map is supplied. Lighting uses the selected pole and an arbitrary display phase.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows source-model radius minus a 0.845 km reference sphere, transferred from the closest point on the full original triangular surface. This prograde radar reconstruction is not an independent topographic survey or gravitational height map. Radar constrained less than half the surface; the unseen hemisphere depends on model assumptions. Ambiguous or out-of-range samples retain the shared grid.
controls.title: Color shows the radius of the closest point on the original triangular source surface minus a 0.845 km reference sphere. It includes global shape and is not height above a gravitational equipotential. This is a derived view of the same radar reconstruction, not an independent topographic measurement. Colors follow the full source surface within the authored simplification-distance limit; ambiguous or out-of-range samples retain the shared missing-data grid. Display resolution adds no observational detail.
